title: Versioning and staged dispatch for new embedding models with compatibility gates
creator: Ayesha Patel
description: Introduce a safer, observable onboarding and versioning workflow for embedding models that prioritizes downstream reranking compatibility, p95 latency stability, and cluster scaling during rollouts. This ticket implements a compatibility gate and staged traffic dispatcher that can route tenants to model variants, run controlled canaries with metric-based gates, and provide fast automated rollback/fallback to previous model versions. The primary drivers are: (1) prevent silent quality regressions on reranking pipelines, (2) limit tail-latency regressions for high-throughput tenants, (3) enable gradual global migration without full reindexing at rollout time.
acceptance_criteria: A model version metadata schema exists (dimensions, dtype, normalization, quantization-tolerance) and is validated on onboarding
Compatibility checker runs as part of model onboarding and rejects models that change embedding_dim or normalization semantics without a migration plan
Staged traffic dispatcher supports: 0/1/5/20/100% allocation steps per tenant and per-route aliases
Canary run produces automated metric report: spearman, recall@k, p95 latency, token cost delta, and these metrics are visible in console
Automated rollback by alias switch completes within 30s and circuit-breaker opens if p95 latency increases > 2x or quality drop > configured threshold
No customer-facing downtime during a staged rollout for tenants with pinned aliases
implementation_plan: Define and store model_version metadata in model registry (json schema + validators)
Build compatibility-checker microservice: static checks (dim, dtype), heuristic checks (norm drift), and offline eval hooks
Extend routing layer to support per-tenant staged dispatch percentages and alias mapping that points to model_version IDs
Add telemetry hooks: embed-eval job that runs offline ranking tests and a canary pipeline that runs online shadow comparisons
Create Console UI for rollout steps, metric gates, and one-click abort/rollback
Add migration helper CLI to compute reindex window estimates and recommendations (deferred reindex strategy)
Document developer and customer playbooks for onboarding and deprecation
test_plan: Unit tests for metadata validator and compatibility rules
Integration tests for routing layer with staged percentages (simulate traffic mix and verify dispatch ratios)
Performance regression tests: baseline + new model p50/p95/p99 latency across QPS profiles
Offline quality suite: compare spearman, recall@10/100, and embedding cosine drift on held-out corpora
Shadow reranking test that runs both old and new model in parallel for a sample of live queries
Canary gate e2e test: assert metrics collection, gate evaluation, and automated rollback behavior
rollback_plan: Immediate alias flip to previous model_version ID (atomic in routing table)
Open circuit-breaker for the affected tenants to force fallback to previous performance tier
Publish incident note with regressions and trigger postmortem if customer impact is high
If quality regression is observed, create a remediation branch (adjust normalization/quant params) and rerun offline evals before next attempt
